fire: The contracting states shall endeavour to align their standards and to exchange data.
Each party shall, to the fullest extent possible, assist the other in good faith.
The signatories undertake to consult regularly and to settle differences amicably.
Members are urged to coordinate their policies, in accordance with their national capacities.
The Authority shall, as far as practicable, consult the regions and promote joint action.
双方应当加强协调，共同维护地区和平与稳定。
Governments should work together to reconcile trade rules and to ensure fair access.
各方应当继续加强沟通，妥善处理分歧。
quiet: The contracting states met in Vienna last spring, and the talks ended early.
Each party arrived with a delegation of about ten people on Monday.
The signatories posed for photographs and then went to lunch.
Members were seated in alphabetical order, in the large hall on the second floor.
The Authority moved its offices to a larger building downtown last year.
双方代表昨天抵达北京，并参观了一家工厂。
Governments published the trade figures on Tuesday and the markets rose.
各方代表上午在酒店吃了早饭，然后合影。

notes: Card: to, comma, and, 应当 in treaty and statute text in English and Chinese; output promotes harmon, reconcile, coordinate, cooper. The negative pole is the verb 'go' (already held), which looks unrelated.
